name: cx-sequence
task: Find the key, pick it up, open the locked door, go into the room, and then pick up the ball.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: the four hard Precedence clauses encode the task's stated order (key found, key picked up, door opened, room entered, then ball picked up), and the hard Existence on target_picked_up forces the whole chain, so no clause is redundant and no stated step is missing.

texts: The agent must find the key before picking it up.
The agent must pick up the key before opening the locked door.
The agent must open the locked door before going into the room.
The agent must go into the room before picking up the ball.
The agent must eventually pick up the ball, the last step of the sequence.
